title: Measurements of Vapor Pressures of Aqueous Solutions in the NaCl-KCl-H2O System from 493.15 to 693.25 K in a Fused Silica Capillary High-Pressure Optical Cell
experimental_method: capillary nonmixing method in a fused silica capillary high-pressure optical cell (Linkam CAP500 stage): sample pressurized with CH4 to a set pressure, heated until a vapor bubble appears (TB), then cooled at 0.5 K/min; the bubble-disappearance temperature TM is taken as the saturation temperature of the set pressure
uncertainties_stated: u(TB) = u(TM) = 0.5 K (473-693 K), u(PS) = 0.097 MPa, u(m) = 0.01 mol/kg; temperature sensor accurate to 0.1 K, +/-0.5 K near 673 K

not_extracted_tables.reason: sources and purities of compounds, no measured data

quality_remarks: Abstract: 493.15 to 693.25 K, NaCl and KCl at 1 and 3 mol/kg, NaCl+KCl mixtures 0.5+0.5, 1+1, 2+2 mol/kg. Table ranges: TM 496.65-650.65 K (Table 2), 499-690 K (Tables 3-4), 497.65-693.25 K (Table 5), PS 2.49-30.1 MPa: consistent with the text.

Table 2: rows with PS above the water critical pressure (22.064 MPa) and TM marked j are critical homogenization temperatures of the H2O-SiO2 (dissolved fused silica) system, not pure-water saturation temperatures; the authors state the pure-water critical point shifts to a critical line Pc = 0.2465 Tc - 137.51. Row 22.0640 (k) is the IAPWS-95 critical point, not a measurement; row 23.0828 (l) is a set pressure with no phase separation. Both have empty TM.
Table 2 rows at PS = 21.2069 MPa have TM 0.4-0.7 K below TC (Delta T negative, positive Delta P) near the critical region.
Table 4: TC and PC cells carry footnotes j/k flagging values extrapolated from Shibue's model (reference-model values, not measured).
Printed TB is superheat temperature (footnote c), larger than TM; not an equilibrium temperature.

Molality of NaCl and KCl printed as mol/kg; per kg of water is not stated. Temperature scale (IPTS-68 or ITS-90) not stated. Water was boiled to remove dissolved gases; pressure medium CH4 (no dissolved CH4 detected by Raman).
Exact duplicate rows (same PS and TM) occur within replicate triplets and are kept.
Footnote k letter is printed on both the PS and TC cell of the critical-point row of Table 2.
